value.name: handles routine legal work
value.description: Asha spends the day on guardianship paperwork, an affidavit, and difficult intake calls that consume her attention.
evidence: The guardianship matter required two telephone calls and a memo. The affidavit took an hour.
The intake calls were both, as intake calls tended to be, longer and stranger than they had appeared on her schedule

value.name: hears intestacy dispute call
value.description: Asha takes a call from a man whose father died intestate and whose siblings are only now discussing the inheritance.
evidence: one of them a man whose father had died intestate in 2019 and whose siblings had decided five years later that this was finally the moment to discuss it

value.name: hears disinheritance inquiry
value.description: Asha takes a call from a woman asking whether she can disinherit her estranged son.
evidence: the other a woman who wanted to know whether she could disinherit a son who had not spoken to her in eleven years and whose name she could not, during the call, bring herself to say aloud

value.name: fixates on moving curtain
value.description: While working, Asha keeps thinking about the second-floor window and the curtain that moved.
evidence: underneath these two activities the other part of her, the part she did not have a name for, was thinking about the second-floor window and the curtain that had moved

value.name: receives call from Lucia
value.description: At two in the afternoon, Asha's assistant connects a call from Lucia.
evidence: At two in the afternoon her assistant put through a call from Lucia.

value.name: Lucia apologizes for calling at work
value.description: Lucia opens the conversation by apologizing for interrupting Asha at work.
evidence: "I am sorry to call you at work," Lucia said.

value.name: Asha reassures Lucia
value.description: Asha tells Lucia that the office line exists for calls like this and asks if she is all right.
evidence: "It is what the office line is for. Are you all right."

value.name: Lucia reports breakfast with Daniel
value.description: Lucia says Daniel came over that morning and they had breakfast together for the first time in a long while.
evidence: "I am all right. I am calling because Daniel came over this morning and we had breakfast together for the first time in I cannot remember how long"

value.name: Lucia explains office-line choice
value.description: Lucia explains she called the office line because she remembered Asha's rule about using the cell only for non-office matters.
evidence: "and I did not want to tell you that on your cell because I remembered you said the office line was for office things"

value.name: Lucia frames personal news as office matter
value.description: Lucia begins to justify her call as an office matter because it concerns something important, but the thought trails off mid-sentence.
evidence: "and this is, I suppose, an office thing, because it concerns the"
